verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance's registered agent service delivers critical legal documents electronically, and its API exposes registered-agent-deliveries endpoints, so the core of receiving documents in an online account is documented. However, the evidence does not explicitly show general state mail being scanned, or in-account reading, downloading or sharing. Missing for 10: explicit scanning of all state mail (not just service of process), documented in-portal viewing/download, sharing with others, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, state mail and legal documents are scanned into an online account where I can read, download, and share them

citations.quote: Receive critical legal documents electronically and be notified by phone when you receive service of process, ensuring you never miss a document.
See due dates, filing status, approved documents, and more.
